title: Culture and Society
summary: 文化差异、国家生活、被动语态和关系从句。
objectives: Describe processes and history in the passive
Use relative clauses to identify people and places

lessons.title: Customs at the Table
lessons.subtitle: 用有保留的语气描述习俗

vocabulary.example: It’s a custom in some families.
The bowls are made from clay.
The theatre was restored in 2015.

listening.title: Customs at the Table
listening.transcript: In my family, guests usually wait for the host to start eating. Some of my friends do things differently, so when I visit someone new, I watch what the host does.

questions.q: What does the speaker do when visiting someone new?

speaking.prompt: 向来访者介绍你家的一条习惯，再礼貌问对方家里怎么做。
speaking.sample: In my family, we usually leave shoes by the door. What do you do at home?

reading.title: 用有保留的语气描述习俗
reading.text: This family asks guests to leave shoes by the door. At other homes in the area, people keep their shoes on. If you’re unsure, ask your host when you arrive.

questions.q: What should an unsure guest do?

writing.prompt: 写 85–105 词比较两个家庭习惯，避免把习惯说成人人都遵守。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（In some families ...；usually / often / may）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: In some families 明确限制说法的范围。
options: Every family does the same thing.

quiz.prompt: What does “custom” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: How Is It Made?
lessons.subtitle: 读懂制作流程的被动语态
grammar: 现在时被动：am/is/are + 过去分词

vocabulary.example: The bowls are made from clay.
The theatre was restored in 2015.
She is a volunteer who helps new visitors.

listening.title: How Is It Made?
listening.transcript: These bowls are made from local clay. They are shaped by hand and left to dry for two days. Then they are heated in a large oven.

questions.q: How long do the bowls dry?

speaking.prompt: 用被动语态向访客说明一种食物或物品的三个制作步骤。
speaking.sample: The bowls are shaped by hand. They are left to dry. Then they are heated in an oven.

reading.title: 读懂制作流程的被动语态
reading.text: At the workshop, tea leaves are picked by hand. They are dried on bamboo trays and packed when they are cool. Visitors can watch the packing at three.

writing.prompt: 写 85–105 词解释一种熟悉物品的制作过程。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（现在时被动：am/is/are + 过去分词）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: 复数主语 bowls 的现在时被动用 are。

quiz.prompt: What does “clay” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: When Was It Built?
lessons.subtitle: 了解地标背景
grammar: 过去时被动：was/were + 过去分词

vocabulary.example: The theatre was restored in 2015.
The bowls are made from clay.
It’s a custom in some families.

listening.title: When Was It Built?
listening.transcript: The bridge was built in 1890. It was damaged in a flood in 1952 and repaired the following year. Today it is used by cyclists and walkers.

speaking.prompt: 像导游一样介绍一个地标，给出建造时间、变化和今天的用途。
speaking.sample: The bridge was built in 1890. It was repaired in 1953. Today people use it to cycle across the river.

reading.title: 了解地标背景
reading.text: The town library was opened in 1930. It was closed for repairs in 2018 and reopened two years later. The reading room still has its original windows.

writing.prompt: 写 85–105 词介绍一个地标，至少用两个过去时被动句。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（过去时被动：was/were + 过去分词）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: 单数主语配 was，表示过去发生的被动动作。

quiz.prompt: What does “restore” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: The People Who Keep It Going
lessons.subtitle: 用关系从句描述人物
grammar: who 引导限定性关系从句，修饰人

vocabulary.example: She is a volunteer who helps new visitors.
The theatre was restored in 2015.
The bowls are made from clay.

listening.title: The People Who Keep It Going
listening.transcript: The people who run this repair café are volunteers. Nia teaches visitors how to fix lamps. Dan welcomes new guests and helps them find the right table.

speaking.prompt: 介绍两位活动志愿者，用 who 补充说明各自职责。
speaking.sample: Nia is a volunteer who teaches people to fix lamps. Dan is the person who welcomes guests.

reading.title: 用关系从句描述人物
reading.text: The group needs people who can speak more than one language. These volunteers welcome visitors at the festival entrance and answer simple questions about the programme.

writing.prompt: 写 85–105 词为社区活动介绍两名人员和他们能提供的帮助。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（who 引导限定性关系从句，修饰人）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: 人作先行词，从句用 who。
quiz.prompt: We need people ___ can answer visitors’ questions.

quiz.explanation: volunteer 在本课中指志愿者。
quiz.prompt: What does “volunteer” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: A Place Where People Meet
lessons.subtitle: 用 where 和 that 解释社区空间
grammar: where 修饰地点；that 可修饰事物

vocabulary.example: Our community has a shared garden.
She is a volunteer who helps new visitors.
The theatre was restored in 2015.

listening.title: A Place Where People Meet
listening.transcript: The community garden is a place where neighbours can grow food together. There’s a shed that holds the tools. New members can borrow tools for free.

speaking.prompt: 用一个 where 从句描述你常去的地方，再用 that 介绍里面的一样东西。
speaking.sample: The library is a place where people can study. It has a screen that shows local events.

reading.title: 用 where 和 that 解释社区空间
reading.text: The old market is a place where local cooks sell lunch. It also has a noticeboard that lists free classes and events. Most stalls open from Tuesday to Saturday.

writing.prompt: 写 90–110 词向新邻居介绍一个社区空间和两项用途。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（where 修饰地点；that 可修饰事物）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Where 表示在这个地点做某事。
quiz.prompt: This is the garden ___ we grow vegetables.
What does “community” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Comparing Everyday Life
lessons.subtitle: 比较生活方式并避免笼统概括
grammar: while / whereas 连接对照信息

vocabulary.example: I walk to work, whereas my brother drives.
Our community has a shared garden.
She is a volunteer who helps new visitors.

listening.title: Comparing Everyday Life
listening.transcript: In my old neighbourhood, most shops closed before seven. In my new neighbourhood, several stay open until ten. My schedule is the same, but shopping after work is easier now.

questions.q: What is easier in the new neighbourhood?

speaking.prompt: 比较你熟悉的两个地方的一项生活安排，说共同点和差异。
speaking.sample: My old neighbourhood had early closing times, whereas shops here stay open later.

reading.title: 比较生活方式并避免笼统概括
reading.text: The two towns run libraries differently. Hilltown opens its library on Sundays, while Brookfield opens late on Thursdays. Both offer free classes once a month.

writing.prompt: 写 90–110 词比较两个地方的交通、店铺营业或社区服务。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（while / whereas 连接对照信息）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Whereas 用于对照两件不同的事。
quiz.prompt: Hilltown opens on Sundays, ___ Brookfield opens late on Thursdays.

quiz.explanation: whereas 在本课中指而；相比之下。
quiz.prompt: What does “whereas” mean in this lesson?

lessons.title: Weekly Challenge: Guide a Visitor
lessons.subtitle: 介绍地标、活动和一条家庭习惯
grammar: 综合被动语态、关系从句和有保留的描述

vocabulary.example: The walk explores the town’s heritage.
I walk to work, whereas my brother drives.
Our community has a shared garden.

listening.title: Weekly Challenge: Guide a Visitor
listening.transcript: The old station was built in 1910 and is now used as a community centre. A volunteer who grew up nearby leads a free tour at eleven. Bring a light jacket because part of the tour is outside.

options: A volunteer who grew up nearby
questions.answer: A volunteer who grew up nearby

speaking.prompt: 为朋友做两分钟口头导览，介绍旧车站、维修活动，再提醒一条访客习惯。
speaking.sample: The station was built in 1910. It’s now a place where neighbours meet. At two you can bring a small item to the repair café.

reading.title: 介绍地标、活动和一条家庭习惯
reading.text: On Saturdays, the centre hosts a repair café at two. The café is a place where visitors bring small broken items. Repairs are free, but a donation is welcome.

questions.q: What should visitors bring if they want help?

writing.prompt: 写 100–120 词欢迎来访者，说明历史、今日活动、集合时间和一条礼貌提示。
checklist: 我完成了题目要求的每一项信息。
我检查了本课表达（综合被动语态、关系从句和有保留的描述）。
我朗读了一遍自己的答案，检查表达是否清晰。

quiz.explanation: Was built 是过去时被动结构。
quiz.prompt: Which sentence uses the past passive?

quiz.explanation: heritage 在本课中指文化遗产。
quiz.prompt: What does “heritage” mean in this lesson?
